docs.summary:
Converts between [`Mesh`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Mesh) and [`GeometryData`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Geometry.GeometryData), so the geometry operators can work on engine meshes.

Mesh vertices that share a position become one geometry vertex, and everything a mesh vertex carries (normal, tangent, UVs, color, skinning, blend shape offsets) is kept per corner on the loops. Split vertices therefore show up as loops at one vertex with different values, which is what the operators treat as seams, so both sides of a split stay joined. Each face records its submesh.

A triangle that reuses corners another triangle already took, like the back of a double sided card, goes onto its own copy of those vertices so each side stays a clean surface. A triangle whose corners share a position gets vertices of its own and is kept as it is.

Skinning comes back in a canonical slot order: sorted by bone, unused slots on bone 0.

members.name: ToMesh
members.signature: public static Mesh ToMesh(GeometryData geometry, Mesh? template = null)

docs.summary: Builds a mesh from geometry. One mesh vertex is made per distinct corner of each geometry vertex. `template` supplies what geometry does not carry: name, bind poses, bone names, blend shape names and frame weights, whether colors were bytes, and the submesh count, so a submesh that lost every triangle still keeps its slot and the material order holds. Without one, byte colors come back as float colors.
